verdict.rationale: Deel is a global HR and payroll SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant host, so consuming external MCP servers' tools (the MCP-client role) falls outside its product role. The evidence documents only the opposite role: Deel runs its own MCP server, which Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and similar clients connect to. That server-side evidence belongs to a different story and earns no credit here, and nothing shows Deel acting as an MCP client.
